portInfo.description: The Freeport of Riga Authority presents Riga as a growing Baltic cruise call. Most cruise ships use Riga Passenger Port on Eksporta iela, described as central and a short walk from Old Town attractions. Operator Rīgas pasažieru osta publishes the same address and cruise service contacts. A future Riga RoPax terminal in Eksportosta is in development planning — do not treat it as today’s gangway. Largest recorded call cited by Freeport: Celebrity Silhouette (319 m LOA, 8.6 m max draught, ~2,700 passengers).

climate.description: Humid continental climate with four distinct seasons

politics.visaRequirements: Entry and visa rules depend on nationality. Many visitors use Schengen short-stay rules, but requirements change—confirm with official government sources and your cruise line before travel.
politics.entryRequirements: Carry a valid passport (or a national ID where your cruise line and destination authorities accept it). Cruise transit formalities can differ from a normal airport entry—follow your ship’s document list.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Riga Passenger Port — 3a Eksporta Street, Riga, LV-1010
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Check the daily programme for your berth and allow extra time on turnaround or tender days.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Art Nouveau streets (Alberta iela area) — transfer time not verified.
thingsToDo.shortCall: ≥4 h. Walk/exit 25 + Old Town 90 + return 25 + 75 min buffer ≈ 215.
thingsToDo.standardCall: ≥6 h. Add Art Nouveau or market (~90) + lunch; 90 min return buffer.
thingsToDo.longerCall: Day trips elsewhere in Latvia are marketed as feasible via the road network but need line coaches and ≥120 min buffer — not verified for self-timed public transport.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: There is no ATM in the terminal — withdraw or use cards in town.
